turns.text: quick q. i need to send rhonda a status update on the scanner fleet and idk if i should mention that im covering greg's stuff. i already submitted the application for permanent desk lead. she said the decision comes after peak, mid-december. dont want to sound pushy

Yes, I'd mention it. A status update is a normal place to do it, and the facts are just facts. Since the application is already in and she's told you the timing, you don't need to argue for anything. You only need to make sure your work is on record.

Keep it to three things:
1. Lead with the fleet status, so it reads as a work update first.
2. State the coverage work as a plain line item with specifics, like vendor tickets, RMAs and scheduling.
3. Don't ask for anything, and don't reference the decision.

Want me to draft it? If so, send me the fleet numbers you'd like in there.

yeah. context tho, acting victor keeps passing me his vendor tickets on his way out so i want it on record who is actually handling them. also my friend talked me into putting the lead coverage on my new resume as my own work and it felt weird. i still want to bring it up to rhonda only sideways. can you word it so it doesnt ask for anything

Sure. A line that reports the work without asking for anything fits that. Here's a draft:

---
Hi Rhonda,

Quick update on the scanner fleet: [fleet status, e.g. number in the repair cage, RMAs outstanding, anything at risk for peak].

For visibility, since Greg's departure I've been handling the vendor tickets, scanner RMA tracking and desk scheduling alongside my normal queue. Those are all current and I'm tracking them in [where you track them], so there's one place to see status.

Happy to share more detail on any of it.

[your name]
---

A few notes:
- "For visibility" keeps it informational, so nothing in it asks for a decision.
- It says what you're doing and where it's tracked, which puts your name on the work without a pitch.
- If you want the vendor tickets to be more explicit, you could add "vendor tickets are now coming to me directly". Only add it if that's accurate, and it makes the record clearer.

If it's still too much, cut the last line and let the facts stand.
